topics.name: Agentic systems and self-improving tool use
topics.summary: These studies build agents that explore tools, learn reusable skills, coordinate multiple workers, and improve from traces; experiments span coding, science, microscopy, and planning, with gains tied to structured feedback and runtime control.

topics.name: Agent memory, evidence retrieval, and long-context grounding
topics.summary: The cluster combines retrieval, graph memories, episodic records, and visual evidence stores for long-context agents. Crisis reports, GUI navigation, code repositories, and embodied tasks show that freshness and provenance determine grounded decisions.

topics.name: AI alignment, safety, and behavior analysis
topics.summary: Across alignment audits, constrained planning, unlearning, and stakeholder studies, these works test how models attribute responsibility, handle risk, and preserve safe behavior under distribution shift or conflicting instructions.

topics.name: Vision-language modeling and multimodal adaptation
topics.summary: These papers adapt vision-language models with structured image-tabular representations, anatomy cues, uncertainty estimates, and external memory for medical, remote-sensing, action, and instructional tasks.

topics.name: Diffusion generation for images, video, and language
topics.summary: Diffusion and latent generative models are evaluated or adapted for few-shot detection, beat tracking, metaphor comprehension, manifold data, and video synthesis, emphasizing controllability and cross-domain generalization.

topics.name: Image restoration and low-light enhancement
topics.summary: Image restoration studies combine physical noise models, proxy-target diagnostics, and illumination-aware networks to recover detail in low-light, backlit, and multiplicative-noise images while exposing failure modes.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and neural rendering
topics.summary: Gaussian splatting, video diffusion, and calibrated 3D targets support compact dynamic fields, large-baseline view synthesis, facial animation, and camera estimation; geometry and temporal consistency drive quality.

topics.name: Visual detection, segmentation, and video understanding
topics.summary: Detection and segmentation systems mix CNN or foundation features with language, graph geometry, interactive correction, and edge deployment across microscopy, medical scans, infrared, video, and scientific imagery.

topics.name: Robot manipulation and embodied world models
topics.summary: Embodied-learning papers use world-action models, affordance representations, memory, tactile or continuum sensing, and failure-aware policies for manipulation, mobile robots, swarms, and articulated objects.

topics.name: Navigation, planning, and autonomous vehicles
topics.summary: Planning and autonomy work combines latent trajectory sampling, UAV or underwater perception, rail sensing, spiking policies, and safety audits to navigate uncertain environments and assess real-world driving behavior.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and music generation
topics.summary: Audio and music systems use self-supervised temporal structure, diffusion or codec latents, hyperbolic adaptation, phoneme-aware rendering, and differentiable effects for speech, soundscapes, talking heads, and composition.

topics.name: Graph and hypergraph learning
topics.summary: Graph methods study noisy hypergraphs, tropical or relational representations, surgical temporal relations, and topology-aware optimization, reporting more stable structure learning and interpretable coordination.

topics.name: Efficient inference, compression, and token or KV reduction
topics.summary: Compression and serving methods reduce visual tokens, KV state, network traffic, model weights, or search cost through pruning, quantization, clustering, distillation, and speculative decoding while tracking quality loss.

topics.name: Language-model training, self-distillation, and optimization
topics.summary: Training studies examine self-distillation, optimization geometry, modality balance, curriculum and scaling, robust fine-tuning, and foundation-model transfer across language, graphs, vision, physics, and control.

topics.name: Federated, private, and distributed learning
topics.summary: Federated and privacy-aware methods exchange sparse updates, soft predictions, or quantized representations under heterogeneous clients; evaluations balance communication, personalization, utility, and protection against leakage or misuse.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical decision support
topics.summary: Clinical AI work covers multimodal decision benchmarks, MRI and ultrasound synthesis, tumor and lesion segmentation, surgical video retrieval, EHR graphs, and contestable care planning, with robustness and factuality as recurring criteria.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and dynamical systems
topics.summary: Temporal modeling papers combine event-adaptive compression, bilinear or reservoir dynamics, counterfactual explanations, sensor fusion, and live load or atmospheric forecasting to handle irregular signals and operational constraints.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and physical simulation
topics.summary: Scientific-ML studies pair neural operators, energy-based surrogates, Bayesian design, and generalized sampling with materials, fluids, structures, weather, and finite-element applications, emphasizing physical constraints and uncertainty.

topics.name: Recommender systems and preference modeling
topics.summary: Recommendation and preference papers model implicit goals, social or market context, fairness, and human choice using graph, causal, and agent-based methods; results emphasize richer preference elicitation over simple ranking.

topics.name: NLP, document intelligence, and multilingual learning
topics.summary: Language research spans translation, multilingual adaptation, document-to-database construction, rhetoric, code and prose generation, and semantic analysis, using curated corpora and structured evaluation to expose cross-lingual and contextual gaps.

topics.name: Generative modeling for biology and structured data
topics.summary: Generative models create or enhance biological and structured scientific data, including MRI, molecular reactions, metabolomics, materials, and ecological or climate fields, with geometry, anatomy, and downstream utility used as constraints.

topics.name: Adversarial robustness and anomaly detection
topics.summary: Robustness work tests anomalous behavior, backdoors, prompt attacks, hallucinations, and failure detection in models and infrastructure, pairing adversarial benchmarks with calibrated monitors, recovery mechanisms, and distribution-shift analysis.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and sequential decisions
topics.summary: Sequential-decision research studies multi-agent coordination, risk-sensitive policies, reward design, preference learning, and planning under partial observability, using simulations and real control settings to measure safety and sample efficiency.

topics.name: Statistical learning theory and uncertainty
topics.summary: Theory and statistical-method papers develop learning guarantees, conformal or probabilistic uncertainty, bandit and regression analyses, and optimization results, connecting finite-sample behavior to reliable decisions.

topics.name: Human-AI interaction and social computing
topics.summary: Human-centered studies examine moderation, immersive interfaces, classroom and workplace support, AI tutors, social deliberation, and theory-of-mind behavior through user studies, mixed methods, and governance-oriented analysis.

topics.name: Information retrieval and search
topics.summary: Search systems combine neural retrieval, graph structure, query reformulation, evidence triangulation, and agentic workflows for crisis, code, finance, and knowledge-graph tasks, emphasizing relevance, provenance, and multi-hop reliability.

topics.name: Hardware-aware and edge AI
topics.summary: Edge and hardware-aware work targets real-time perception, tiny models, embedded sensing, neural accelerators, and resource-constrained software, reporting latency or energy trade-offs alongside accuracy.

topics.name: Data-centric benchmarks and evaluation
topics.summary: Benchmark and data-centric papers build or audit datasets for video, coding, financial reporting, safety, visual decisions, and scientific reasoning, showing how rubric quality, difficulty, leakage, and task design alter conclusions.

topics.name: Explainability and mechanistic analysis
topics.summary: Interpretability studies use attribution, sparse features, latent probes, and representation analyses to inspect model confidence, circuits, visual explanations, and social or cognitive behavior, often finding that common proxies miss important mechanisms.

topics.name: Optimization, control, and operations research
topics.summary: Optimization and control papers develop constrained planners, bandit allocation, verifier-guided synthesis, nonlinear tracking, topological operators, and operational audits for engineering and AI systems under uncertainty.

topics.name: Privacy, fairness, and responsible AI
topics.summary: Responsible-AI work evaluates fairness, privacy, system integration, oversight, and institutional accountability using audits, constrained selection, stakeholder evidence, and failure analyses rather than aggregate accuracy alone.
